data_notes.explanation: Prices are cleaned before use (app/trading/price_quality.py): day/month-swapped duplicate rows and off-calendar rows removed, single-day bad prints dropped, and moves beyond NEPSE's ±10% circuit treated as bonus/right-share adjustments with earlier prices back-adjusted.

method.fills: Orders decided after a session's close fill at the next session's close.
method.costs: Tiered broker commission, SEBON 0.015%, Rs 25 DP charge, 5%/7.5% CGT.
method.limits: 10-share buy lot, max 10% of a day's volume, no short selling.
